On this page

prefer-line-exists ​

Category: Clean ABAP & Modern Syntax  |  Severity: warning  |  Finding Code: PREFLINEX  |  QuickFix: No

Description ​

Prefer line_exists( ) over READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.

❌ Non-Compliant Code ​

abap
DATA lt_tab TYPE string_table.
READ TABLE lt_tab TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS WITH KEY table_line = ''.

✅ Compliant Code ​

abap
DATA lt_tab TYPE string_table.
DATA ls_row TYPE string.
READ TABLE lt_tab INTO ls_row INDEX 1.

🤫 Suppression & Pseudo-Comments ​

To suppress findings for this rule, append the pseudo-comment or pragma to the statement:

abap
" Using pseudo-comment:
... "#EC LINE_EXISTS

" Using pragma:
... ##LINE_EXISTS.

Configuration (skylint.yaml) ​

yaml
checks:
  prefer-line-exists:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning

ABAP Class Details ​

  • Native ATC Class: ZCL_SKYLINT_PREF_LINE_EXISTS
  • Implementation File: zcl_skylint_pref_line_exists.clas.abap
